LanguageData.RequiresCombatExtended: This version of the mod requires Combat Extended as a dependency.
LanguageData.DisableWeaponsDesc: Removes the Ancient Charged Arms weapons from spawning, trading, quest rewards and crafting. Requires a restart.
LanguageData.DisableNewAmmo: Patch mod ammo into stock ammo
LanguageData.DisableNewAmmoDesc: Instead of leaving N.E, NANO and Antigrain as the mod's advanced rounds, each of them is patched into the stock Combat Extended ammo ticked below: same ammo class, ballistics, cook-off and inventory footprint. The weapons keep their own ammo sets. Requires a restart.
LanguageData.SwitchesNeedRestart: Changes to the two switches take effect after restarting RimWorld.
LanguageData.AmmoFallbackSameCaliberDesc: Every N.E, NANO and Antigrain round becomes the stock charge round of the same caliber, for example 6x24mm Charged.
LanguageData.AmmoFallbackMechDesc: Every N.E, NANO and Antigrain round becomes the universal Mech Charged cartridge, the ammo mechanoid weapons use. With the same-caliber box ticked as well, the rounds become plain charge ammo and the Mech Charged cartridge is added to the weapons' ammo sets instead.
